{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining non-numeric entries after conversion
invalid_revenue = sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum()

# Display the first few rows after conversion
top_rows_after = sales_df[['revenue']].head()

# Check for any negative values (which might indicate error)
has_negative = (sales_df['revenue'] < 0).sum()

invalid_revenue, top_rows_after, has_negative"}
